title: Zero density theorems for short intervals
summary: Explicit zero-density results for the Riemann zeta function in short intervals, formalized in Lean 4 over Mathlib. Count the nontrivial zeros whose imaginary part lies in a window (t-h, t+h], with multiplicity and with a zero on either horizontal edge counted for half. Seven statements are submitted, and all seven are mechanically checked. Two are zero-density bounds for the edge strip Re s > 1-alpha, valid for 0 1 - conj(rho), proved in the development to be a multiplicity-preserving involution of the zero set.
